text.en:
Repeal of Executive Order No. 157, series of 2002. Executive Order
No. 157, series of 2002 is hereby repealed.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28thof February in the year of Our Lord,
two thousand and three.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
PMS LIBRARY BCODE009558
Para Hologram / 18400
